tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅/ /tshe rta'i sngon 'gro bsdus pa gcig bzhugs so//

༄༅// nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du tshe dbang zab mo zhu snyam pa gcig dgos te/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs// zhes gsungs pas so// de yang 'o skol rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon/ de bzhin bstan pa rin po che bzhugs pa'i dus su skyes pa/ shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin/ de dus gtan gyi don gyi snying po len dgos/ ma blangs na thob pa don med du song ba yin/ 'o na gtan gyi snying po ji ltar len na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa dkon mchog rten du khas len pas/ rgyu'i skyabs 'gro/ de nas dam pa'i chos ston/ tshogs bsdu bar bya'o snyam pas 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gal che/ de yang rgyu skyabs su 'gro ba la/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la skyabs kyi dngos gzhi/ dge 'dun la byang chub sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu snyam pa gyis la/ thog mar gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs nas/ bla ma bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba bgyid snyam pa dang*/ skyabs su song bas thar pa'i sgor tshud/ rnam par thar pa'i snod du rung bar gyur kyang*/ sems bskyed pa rnam pa gsum gang rung dang mi ldan na byang chub mi thob pas sems bskyed dgos/ rnam pa gsum yang*/ mdo las/ la la dag nyan thos kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed do// la la dag rang sangs rgyas su sems bskyed do// la la dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do// zhes gsungs pa de yin la/ de las nyan rang gnyis rang gcig po zhi bde 'dod pas dman/

theg chen ni sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam dam bca' zhing de ltar bcas pa yin pas/ ci nas kyang de'i ched du 'gyur bar rtsom pa thams cad la sbyar bar bya bas/ sems bskyed pa de yang cho ga 'dis 'grub pa yin pas/ 'di'i rjes bzlos gyis/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan dang po song*/ gnyis pa'i rjes bzlos gyis/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ gsum pa'i rjes bzlos so// de ltar skyabs su song nas/ gang zhu na/ sems can thams cad kyi don rgya chen po sgrub/ de la tshe ring bar dgos pa 'dug de'i phyir tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang zhu bsam pa gyis/ de la lugs mang yang*/ 'dir rje btsun ras chung pas rgya gar du byon/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo dang mjal/ 'chi med tshe'i gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam zhus pa'i nang nas/ phyi sgrub lha gcig bum gcig 'di/ bskyed rim la brten pa'i dmigs pa yin pas sems ma yengs pa gyis/ tshe rta'i sngon 'gro bsdus pa 'di mi pham pad+ma dkar pos rta sdings su sbyar ba'o// maṅgalaṃ///
